title: Crestline Credit Card Parts Reduction on Alignment Services & Plans Work Orders
content:
On the latest work order of an Alignment Services & Plans plan, a cardholder parts reduction takes a percentage of the kit charge off the parts charge. It is read from the customer's Crestline Credit Card account and the late fees posted to it in the 12 calendar months up to the pricing.

| Customer's Crestline Credit Card account | Late fee posted in the 12 calendar months up to the pricing | Reduction, as a percentage of the kit charge |
|---|---|---|
| Active | none | 5% |
| Active | one or more | 2% |
| No active account | — | 0% |

The reduction is worked out on its own, as a percentage of the kit charge, and taken off the parts charge, which is rounded to the nearest cent.

*Hypothetical:* on a kit charge of 90.00, 4.50 is taken off for a holder of an active card account with no late fee in the period, and 1.80 with a late fee in the period.
